end.summary:
Identified cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Practised sorting solids by flat and curved faces.
Chose cylinder for a rocket body and cone for its pointed tip.
Initially called every box a cube; later corrected this by checking for equal square faces.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised naming solid shapes in familiar objects and explaining shape choices for a rocket. Asha used face shape, face count and whether a solid has a point to guide the explanations. Aditya first called a matchbox and a box cubes, then corrected this later by noting that a cuboid has longer, unequal faces. At home, ask them to find one cube and one cuboid and check whether all faces are equal squares.
